newsitem.title: USA: U.S. speeds up SPR oil auction to weekly bids.
newsitem.headline: U.S. speeds up SPR oil auction to weekly bids.

text.p: High oil prices has made the U.S. Energy Department decide to speed up its ongoing auction from the Strategic Petroleum Reserve to receive bids weekly instead of every two weeks, a department official said Friday.

The Defense Fuel Supply Center, which is running the sale, "recommended accelerating the bid cycles to a weekly basis (the original intent was to receive bids every two weeks) to take advantage of favorable market conditions," the Energy Department said.

The government this week sold 1.47 million barrels of sweet and sour crude at an average $22.51 per barrel in the first round of the auction, which was ordered by Congress to raise $220 million to help trim the federal budget deficit.
